payload.body: Done. New auth_lifecycle module (AuthLifecycle trait: on_first_sign_in + resolve_session, NoopAuthLifecycle default) injected via BootSeams.auth_lifecycle, threaded through finish_provider_login + email signup. Runs once on first sign-in (email/Apple/Google), writes through the store, can override session user_id/display_name/tenant; returning sign-ins reuse the account. Committed f6f5364 (+ codegen fix 5328070). Workspace 1000 tests + TS 423 + clippy/fmt/verify:generated green.
